title: What to do in an Emergency

instruction.text: What should you do when there’s a big fire that you can’t put out by yourself? Select all the correct answers.

objects.sound: look for other people in the building

text: Correct! When there’s a big fire, you should get yourself to safety as quickly as possible. Even if there are still other people in the building, you should not go back inside to save them. The fire brigade will do that as soon as they get there.

instruction.text: When there’s a fire, you should leave the building quickly. There is an official sign that shows you the evacuation route to the emergency exit. Select the correct sign.
What number do you call for the fire brigade? Put in the emergency call number digit by digit.

hint.text: You'll reach the fire brigade by calling 999.
hint.sound: You'll reach the fire brigade by calling 9 9 9

instruction.text: Now select the green call button to start the call.
Fill in the dialogue between the fire control operator and Miss Harrison.

atoms.b: Hello, this is the London Fire Brigade. ((++What)) has happened?
A ((++fire)) has started at White Lake Primary School.
((++Where)) exactly is this fire? Please could you give me the ((++address)) of the school?
Do you know if there is anyone still in ((++danger))?
When the ((++fire_alarm)) rang, all the classes left the building together. I think everyone is ((safe)).
Many thanks for the information. Please get yourself and all the pupils to safety. We will be there as ((++quickly)) as possible.
